products.name: tl;dv
products.note: Meeting recorder AI; timestamped notes; EU-hosted; GDPR; consent management

reading.body:
tl;dv offers meeting recording and summarization across 30+ languages with user data kept off AI training pipelines, positioning itself as a cheaper alternative to competitors like Gong.

The product sits at the junction of three capabilities: recording, transcription, and automated note generation. The company's claim that recordings will not train its AI, combined with EU hosting and GDPR compliance, signals a choice to treat customer conversations as confidential rather than as training fuel. This matters because most meeting intelligence platforms treat content as a training asset. The partnership with Anthropic for generative features, with metadata anonymization and randomized processing, suggests tl;dv offloads AI compute while trying to maintain user privacy guarantees.

For an AI company, this approach trades a potential data moat for user trust and regulatory compliance. The free tier with no time limits requires the company to absorb hosting and transcription costs at scale. Transcription alone, across 30+ languages and millions of meetings, generates consistent computational demand. That demand sits downstream of data center capacity and power availability. EU data residency adds infrastructure constraints that a US-only platform avoids.

The data does not show revenue, user scale, or which languages consume the most compute. It also does not specify whether the company owns transcription infrastructure or licenses it. Whether the free tier and low-cost paid plans are sustainable at scale depends on factors the profile does not reveal.

profile_text.body:
tl;dv is an AI-powered meeting recorder and notetaker founded in 2021. The name stands for "Too Long, Didn't View." The product automatically records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings, generating timestamped notes, follow-up email drafts, and next-step tasks based on call content. It supports transcription and translation across more than 30 languages and dialects, and integrates with CRMs, ticketing systems, knowledge management platforms, and what the company describes as over 5,000 other tools. The company positions tl;dv as suitable for sales, customer success, and internal meetings.

Beyond note-taking, the company describes tl;dv as a sales coaching platform, offering features such as playbook adherence tracking, objection handling analysis, and AI-selected clip libraries for onboarding new hires. Sales managers can use it to monitor representative performance in real time. The platform also generates aggregated reports from multiple meetings to surface trends and insights. The company offers a free tier with no time limits, and contrasts this with what it characterizes as a $5,000 or more upfront investment required by Gong.

On data handling, the company states that recordings and transcripts belong to users and will not be used to train AI. The platform is described as GDPR-compliant and SOC 2-certified, with data stored in ISO 27001-certified data centers using AES-256 encryption. tl;dv partners with Anthropic for generative AI capabilities, anonymizing metadata and processing meetings in randomized chunks. The held facts confirm the product is EU-hosted with consent management features, and the company's profile was verified as of August 2026.
